name: Third-Party Payments and Commingling
description: Use of third parties to make or receive payments, and the mixing of illicit funds with legitimate funds in business, personal or client accounts, to obscure source and ownership. Includes accounts used by someone other than the holder.

sources.text: FATF, Guidance for a Risk-Based Approach: The Banking Sector (2014)
Wolfsberg Group, Wolfsberg AML Principles / Wolfsberg Guidance on Customer Due Diligence

exposure.rationale: Unrelated third-party payers/payees and commingling in personal/business accounts.

indicators.name: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
indicators.canon: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
indicators.desc: Funds are paid or received, or instructions are given to pay, through parties with no evident link to the customer, contract, debt or insured interest. Includes third-party cheques, loan repayments, premiums, gaming funds and goods payments not matching the documentation.
indicators.ctx: Payers or payees have no apparent link to the customer.

indicators.name: Personal account used for business flows
indicators.canon: Personal account used for business flows

indicators.name: Illicit and legitimate funds mixed in operating account
indicators.canon: Illicit and legitimate funds mixed in operating account
indicators.desc: Business income blended with unexplained inflows.
indicators.ctx: Business income blended with unexplained inflows.

indicators.name: Account controlled by someone other than holder
indicators.canon: Account controlled or used by someone other than the holder
indicators.desc: Signs that a third party holds the card, PIN, credentials or device, or that funds and activity belong to someone other than the named holder.
indicators.ctx: Signs of third-party control such as shared devices, mandates.

indicators.name: Client or pooled accounts used for non-client flows
indicators.canon: Client or pooled accounts used for non-client flows
indicators.desc: Professionals' client accounts used as banks.
indicators.ctx: Professionals' client accounts used as banks.

indicators.name: Transfers pass through accounts of relatives or employees
indicators.canon: Transfers pass through accounts of relatives or employees
indicators.desc: Staff or family accounts used for business flows.
indicators.ctx: Staff or family accounts used for business flows.

indicators.name: Frequent payments to the same third-party beneficiary of unclear purpose
indicators.canon: Frequent payments to the same third-party beneficiary of unclear purpose

indicators.name: Loans or deposits from unknown persons into company accounts
indicators.canon: Related-party or unknown-party loans and deposits lacking documentation
indicators.desc: Intercompany loans, director deposits or loans from unknown persons with no agreements, interest or repayment terms.
indicators.ctx: Directors or others deposit funds without documentation.
